Commentary.Commentary: The Lankan bowling appeared to be flat on Day 1 but still they managed to pick six wickets. This morning though they received some support from the wicket, especially the spinners, and they snapped the remaining four wickets by giving away 54 runs. It was a decent effort by the African tail to push the total past the 400-run mark. Lasith Embuldeniya had a struggle yesterday but bounced back to claim a 4-fer. The bowling from the Islanders was better and with Dhananjaya also accounting for 3 wickets, it's an indication that the spinners will enjoy the conditions more. Sri Lanka have opted for the light roller and their openers will be out soon to begin their reply...

Fantastic effort by Zimbabwe to post a sizable first innings total on the board! Electing to bat, Kevin Kasuza once again showed good temperament in his knock of 38 and the real partnership came between the experienced pair of Sean Williams and Sikandar Raza. The Zimbabwean skipper notched up a fine century while Raza and Taylor also lent good support.

OUT! Dhananjaya takes a sharp catch! Tossed up ball landing full outside off, Nyauchi stretches forward to defend but it spins away to take the outside edge. De Silva at first slip immediately reacts to his right and snaps a low catch with one hand. Embuldeniya finishes with a 4-wicket haul and ZIMBABWE ARE ALL OUT FOR 406!
Closer to the off and spinning away, Nyauchi stays back to push inside the line but misses.
Tossed up ball outside off, left alone.
Mumba keeps this tossed up ball out off the back foot.

DROPPED! Good effort but in vain. Short in length and outside off, Nyauchi cuts it hard from the crease to point where de Silva flies to his left but fails to hold on to the catch. They cross for a run. A good effort in the field nonetheless.
Yorker spot on. The batsman digs it out superbly.
Physio rushes out! The mandatory concussion test is performed and the batsman is found to be perfectly fine to continue. Nyauchi can continue to bat...

Nasty from Kumara. Nyauchi is down on his knees. Kumara goes short on off, Victor looks to duck it but the ball does not bounce as much as expected. It hits Nyauchi on the grille and rolls past the stumps. The umpire calls for the physio for the mandatory check and Victor is fine to continue.
Full on off, driven towards covers.
FOUR! Victor is into the act now. He flicks this length ball off his pads through mid-wicket. The ball has enough on it to rolls over the ropes there.
Lahiru Kumara (19-5-55-1) is back on.
FOUR! This time he gets it right. Mumba once again goes for the sweep and this time middles it. It races through square leg and finds the fence. 400 UP FOR ZIMBABWE!

Mumba goes for the sweep but misses it only to get hit on the pads. The bowler and other players appeal but the umpire is unmoved. Mumba did well there to get himself outside the line of off stump while playing the sweep.
Full on middle and leg, pushed off the full face of the bat towards the bowler.
Full on off, pushed towards the off side.
Floated outside off, defended towards covers.
Full on middle, driven towards mid on.
Full on middle, driven down to long on for a run.
Outside off, kept out.
Victor now runs it past point for a single.
BEATEN! Quicker through the air and outside off, Victor looks to defend it off the back foot but the ball beats his push inside the line and settles into the mitts of the keeper.
Flatter on middle, tucked towards square leg for a single.
Tossed up on middle, defended towards short leg.
Victor Nyauchi is the last man in for Zimbabwe.

OUT! Embuldeniya gets his third wicket! He dishes out a flighted full ball around off, Tiripano finds it in his half and tries to pump it over the infield at mid off. The fielder there is standing a few steps behind than the usual position and it's an easy catch for him. Suranga Lakmal is the concerned fielder and Zimbabwe lose their 9th wicket with their score still six runs short of 400!
Very full and on middle, Tiripano sweeps it down to fine leg and returns for the second run.
Spinning away from the batsman, from around off, Mumba stays back to push inside the line and gets it away off the outside edge. It beats first slip and they take a run.
FOUR! Helped on its way. Zimbabwe's score enters into the 390s! Flighted ball, too full and around leg, Mumba goes down on one knee and sweeps it fine down the leg side for a boundary.

Mumba blocks this one off the back foot.
Floated down the leg side, Mumba lets it be.

The bowler appeals immediately and the umpire raises his finger. De Silva is fine on the front foot and Mutombodzi has to depart after fighting it out. The ball was probably going onto hit the middle stump. Fair decision.

Full on middle and leg, defended to the leg side.

Tossed up outside off, left alone.
Loopy ball on off, defended off the front foot towards covers.
Floated on off, kept out off the front foot.
Flatter on off, pushed off the back foot towards mid-wicket.
Floated on off, blocked off the front foot.

This pitch certainly is showing more support to the bowlers than it was on Day 1. The spinner is getting it to grip and spin and here Lakmal gets some outswing going. He delivers it on a length outside off, the line is too wide to bother the batsman though.

Half a shout for an lbw! Lakmal angles in a good length ball from around off, Mutombodzi gets across the stumps a bit to flick but misses. He is hit high on the pads and hence the appeal dies down quickly.

Donald Tiripano is in next. He's no mug with the bat and showed his talent in the first match. Can he add vital runs to the score and stretch it to 400?

Dickwella is quick behind the wickets as he gobbles up the catch into his mitts. He jumps in an appeal and the finger is up in no time. This is a big blow to Zimbabwe's aspiration to reach somewhere around 450!

We are all set to start Day 2 as the Sri Lankan players take their respective fielding positions. The two overnight batsmen for Zimbabwe Regis Chakabva and Tinotenda Mutombodzi walk out to resume their innings. Mutombodzi will face the first ball. Suranga Lakmal will start with the ball for Sri Lanka.

Day 1 was a combination of good bowling and batting where both the teams put on a good display but it's the home side that will be feeling on top. Zimbabwe rode on the ton of their skipper to end on 352 although they lost 6 wickets in the process too. The pitch is still good to bat on and the two overnight batsmen, Chakabva and Mutombodzi, will try to score some useful runs in the morning session. On the contrary, Sri Lanka would hope that the last 4 wickets are taken quickly to restrict Zimbabwe's march towards a big first innings score. Hello and welcome to the coverage of Day 2 of the 2nd Test between Sri Lanka and Zimbabwe and thank you for joining us again. Stay tuned as the action is not far away...
... Day 2, Session 1...

So, what to expect on Day 2? The visitors need to pick up the remaining wickets as quickly as possible and not let Zimbabwe run away with the game. The hosts, on the other hand, will look to bat deep and add as many runs as possible. Can Sri Lanka restrict Zimbabwe below 400 or will the hosts continue to pile on the runs? Join us on Tuesday, 28th January, 2020 at 1000 Local (0800 GMT) for the second day. Until then, cheers.

Sri Lankan bowlers toiled hard with the ball. They started well as they picked up two wickets in no time. That's when things started going downhill for them. The spinners were rendered ineffective as Brendan Taylor, Kevin Kasuza, Sean Williams and Sikandar Raza took them apart with some excellent batting. Embuldeniya was disappointing as he went for over 5 runs an over. Suranga Lakmal was the pick of the bowlers as he picked up two wickets and was economical as well. Overall, it was a tiring day for the Lankans.

A day which has belonged to the Rhodesians. They started slowly and were going at a snail's pace in the first hour of the day. That plan did not work for them as they lost two quick wickets. That brought Brendan Taylor to the crease and he along with Kevin Kasuza took the attack to the spinners and were involved in a quickfire 65-run stand. Soon after Lunch, Kasuza fell and Taylor followed him after scoring a run-a-ball 62. Then came the partnership which took Zimbabwe to safer shores. Sean Williams and Sikandar Raza stitched a 159-run stand with the former getting to his 2nd Test ton and Raza helping himself to his 7th Test fifty. They both fell in quick succession but Mutombodzi and Chakabva have seen the remaining overs without any hiccups.

The Lankan bowlers, on the other hand, started off decently. They kept it nice and tight in the first hour. However, the spinners have had no answer to this counter-attacking cricket from Taylor and Kasuza in the second. They have got the ball turn a little but the Zimbabwe batters have tackled it nicely. What different can we see from the Lankans in the second session? We will find out shortly.

Both Taylor and Kasuza have really played well so far and are amidst a good stand. Also, it is a much-needed one as Zimbabwe lost two wickets quite early. The hosts will hope the two can continue and make this start a significant one.

The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Floated around off, Ervine looks to defend but misses to get hit on the thigh pad. There is an appeal for LBW but the umpire shakes his head.
TOP EDGE BUT SAFE! Loopy delivery on middle, Kasuza looks to sweep but it takes the top edge and goes towards mid-wicket. Luckily for Kasuza, the ball lands safely. A single taken.
Flatter delivery on middle, Kasuza defends it back to the bowler.
EDGY! Floated on off, Kasuza looks to defend but it takes the outside edge and goes past the first slip fielder towards third man. Two taken.
Kumara dishes a full ball on middle, Ervine defends it back to the bowler.
Outside off, Ervine shoulders arms to this one.
Good length ball on middle, whipped to mid-wicket for a single.
Length delivery on off, Kasuza drives it to mid off.
Back of a length ball on middle, Kevin defends it to mid on.
Short ball around middle,  Kasuza ducks under it.

FOUR! Off the mark in style! Slightly fuller again and outside off, Ervine gets to the pitch of the ball, strokes it uppishly but in the gap in the cover region for a boundary. A good over for Zimbabwe.
Nicely played! Good fielding too! Flighted ball on off, Kasuza plays it with the turn towards covers. The fielder there dives and saves at least two for his side. one taken.
Angled into the pads, Kasuza works it towards short leg.
Extremely full this time and on middle, it is jammed out back to the bowler.
FOUR! Excellent shot. A very safe one too. This is tossed up on middle, it is a little too full. Kasuza lofts it over the bowler's head and it goes for a one bounce boundary.
Floats it up on middle, it is kept out.
Craig Ervine is the new man in. Lasith Embuldeniysa is into the attack.

OUT! CAUGHT! Finally, Sri Lanka have broken through! This is a poor shot though. Good length delivery outside off, Masvaure looks to drive without moving his feet. He gets a thick outside edge and goes towards the keeper. Niroshan Dickwella makes no mistake behind the stumps and starts celebrating rightly so.
Short ball outside off, Masvaure punches it to point.
Inside edge saves Masvaure! Full delivery on off, Masvaure looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads. If he had misses, would have been close.
Shorter one outside off, Masvaure sways away from it.
Kumara bends his back and bowls a short one on middle, Masvaure though is not too perturbed as he defends this one to cover.
Full delivery outside off, Masvaure shoulders arms to it.

DRINKS! Zimbabwe have started sedately. They are going at a run rate of just around 1. Sri Lanka have bowled well but have been unrewarded so far. They will look to get wickets as quickly as possible.
Full delivery outside off, Kasuza shoulders arms to this one.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Good length ball on off, coming back in sharply. Kasuza looks to defend but it takes the inside edge and gets stuck in the flap of the pad.
Full delivery on off, pushed to mid off.
FOUR! Too straight from Fernando and it has been put away. Full delivery on the pads, Kasuza whips it through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
EDGY! Good length ball on off, Kasuza looks to defend but it takes the outside edge and goes to gully on one bounce.
Fullish on off, Masvaure pushes it to mid off.
Length ball on off, Masvaure defends it to mid off.

Well fielded! Full delivery outside off, Kasuza drives it through the cover region for three. Lakmal chases after it and cleans it up. The umpires check whether it is a boundary but Lakmal has done a good job there.
On a length on off, Kevin defends it to cover.
Good length ball on off, Kasuza looks to defend but it takes the inside edge, hits the pads. Kasuza kicks the ball away as he thinks that it might hit the stumps.
BOUNCER! It is bowled around middle and leg, Kasuza ducks under it.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Inside edge! Angled into the left-hander. Masvaure looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Edgy run! Shorter and around off, Kasuza looks to defend but it hits the outside edge and goes past the gully fielder for one.
Three now! Width on offer again, short and outside off. Masvaure slaps it through covers. It stops as it reaches near the ropes. Three taken.
This is angled into the batter, Masvaure works it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Just about gets to the ropes! First boundary of the game! A half volley, very full and wide outside off. Masvaure leans into it and creams it through the cover region for a boundary.
Vishwa Fernando is back on! Change of ends for him.
Good length on off, Kasuza defends it out.
Fullish delivery outside off, Kasuza makes another leave.
Good length ball outside off, Kevin lets the ball go to the keeper.
On off, Kasuza lunges forward and drives it to cover.
Full delivery on off, Kasuza drives it to mid off for nothing.
Kumara starts with a length delivery on middle, Kasuza looks to defend but it takes the inside half of the bat and the ball rolls to mid-wicket.
First change of the game! Lahiru Kumara is into the attack.
Length ball on off, Masvaure pushes it to cover.
Short of a length on middle, Kasuza tucks it to deep square leg for a single. Lakmal finally concedes a run.
Full delivery outside off, Kevin leaves it alone.
Lakmal dishes a full ball on middle, Kasuza defends it to mid on.
Full delivery on off, Kasuza prods forward and defends it out.
Length ball on off, Kasuza defends it to mid off.
Full delivery on off, Masvaure drives but it lands just in front of the bowler and rolls to mid off.
Fernando dishes a fuller one outside off, Masvaure lets the ball through to the keeper.
Length on middle, tucked to fine leg for a single.
Full delivery on middle, Kasuza pushes it down to mid on.
Length ball on the pads, Kasuza looks to tuck it to the leg side. He misses and gets hit on the thigh pad.
Full delivery on middle, Kasuza works it to mid-wicket.
On a length on off, Masvaure solidly defends it to the cover fielder. 4 maidens in a row from Lakmal.
Good length ball on middle, Prince defends it to mid on.
On middle, worked to mid-wicket.
Good length ball on middle and leg, Prince works it to square leg. He wants the single but is sent back by Kasuza.
Back of a length ball on off, Masvaure pushes it to cover.
Good length ball down the leg side, Masvaure looks to flick but fails to get any bat on it.
Length ball on the pads, Masvaure looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. The ball rolls to square leg and the batters manage to take a leg bye.
Good length ball outisde off, Masvaure pushes it through the gully region for a couple.
Length ball on off, pushed to point.
Outside off, left alone.
Good length ball on middle, Masvaure stands tall and defends it off the back foot.
BEATEN! Good length ball outside off, Masvaure still pokes at it but fails to get any bat on it.
Good length ball on middle, Kasuza works it to mid-wicket.
Good length delivery on off, Kasuza taps it to point.
Good length ball outside off, Kasuza shoulders arms to this one.
Good length ball on the pads, Kasuza works it to mid-wicket.
Full delivery outside off, Kevin shoulders arms to this one.
BEATEN! Beautiful delivery from Lakmal. Good length ball outside off, Kasuza looks to defend but misses it altogether.
Good length ball outside off, Masvaure looks to leave but it takes the bottom edge and goes towards gully.
Good length ball on off, Masvaure defends it to point.
Good length ball on middle, Prince blocks it to cover.
Good length ball on middle, Masvaure defends it to point.
Very full delivery on middle, Kasuza looks to dig it out but it takes the inside edge, hits the pads and rolls to square leg. The batters take a run and Zimbabwe are finally off the mark.
Full delivery outside off, Kasuza shoulders arms to it.
Fullish delivery on middle, Prince pushes this down to mid on.
Good length ball outside off, Prince does not fiddle with it and leaves it alone.
Good length ball on off, Masvaure looks to flick but the ball takes the inside edge and hits the pads.
Fullish delivery outside off, Masvaure shoulders arms to this one.
Full delivery on off, Prince lunges and drives it to mid off.
Good length ball on off, Masvaure pushes it to point.
Fullish on middle, pushed to mid on. Two maidens to start with from the Lankans.
Good length ball on middle and leg, worked to mid-wicket.
Full toss on middle, Kasuza works it to square leg.
Good length ball outside off, left alone by Kasuza.
On middle, Kasuza pushes it back to the bowler.
Fernando starts with a fuller one outside off, Kasuza lets the ball go to the keeper.
Vishwa Fernando will bowl from the other end.
Lakmal dishes a full delivery on off, Masvaure looks to drive but it takes the outside edge and rolls to point. Maiden to start with from Suranga Lakmal.
Just short of Lakmal! Full delivery on middle, Masvaure looks to defend but it takes the top half of the bat and goes uppishly towards the bowler. Lakmal dives ahead but the ball falls short.
Good length ball on middle, Masvaure works it to the mid-wicket.
Fullish delivery on off, Masvaure defends it to mid off.
Good length ball on middle, Masvaure defends it to the bowler.
Starts off with a length ball around middle, it tails back in a touch. It is pushed back to the bowler.
We are all set to begin! Kevin Kasuza and Prince Masvaure are out in the middle as the openers for Zimbabwe. The Sri Lankan players follow them out. Suranga Lakmal will start for the visitors.

Zimbabwe (Playing XI) - Prince Masvaure, Kevin Kasuza, Brendan Taylor, Craig Ervine, Sean Williams(c), Sikandar Raza, Regis Chakabva(w), Donald Tiripano, Tinotenda Mutombodzi (In place of Ainsley Ndlovu), Victor Nyauchi, Carl Mumba (In place of Kyle Jarvis).

Sri Lanka (Playing XI) - Dimuth Karunaratne (c), Oshada Fernando, Kusal Mendis, Angelo Mathews, Dinesh Chandimal, Dhananjaya de Silva, Niroshan Dickwella (wk), Suranga Lakmal, Lasith Embuldeniya, Lahiru Kumara, Vishwa Fernando (In place of Kasun Rajitha).
Zimbabwe win the toss and choose to bat first.

Sri Lanka defeated Zimbabwe comfortably in the first Test. Angelo Mathews and Suranga Lakmal were the stars for the visitors. They would look to come up with another terrific performance and win the series 2-0. Zimbabwe, on the other hand, batted well in the first innings but collapsed badly in the second. They would hope that they perform better with the willow in hand and level the series. Welcome to our coverage of the second and final Test of this series. Do join us in a while.
